slides.title: Restaurant owner on my one day off:

slides.label: Me
slides.title: Sleeping in until 8. Luxury.
slides.body: Phone on silent. Living my best life.

slides.label: The back of my head
slides.title: "Wait. When does the health permit renew?"
slides.body: Is it this month? It feels like this month.

slides.label: The back of my head
slides.title: "Did the new line cook ever get a food handler card?"
slides.body: And the dishwasher. And the one who started Tuesday.

slides.label: Me
slides.title: Watching a movie on the couch.
slides.body: Not thinking about work at all.

slides.label: The back of my head
slides.title: "Liquor license. Hood cleaning cert. The insurance renewal email."
slides.body: Which inbox did that go to?

slides.title: I just want to be okay.
slides.body: Put every renewal date in one place that reminds you. Then take the day off for real. Save this.
